title: Production-grade slugify() with options for HiveFund URLs
description: Implement an ES module slugify.mjs exporting slugify(input: string, options?: { separator?: "-" | "_" | "."; maxLength?: number }): string. Rules, applied in this order: (1) Transliterate before normalizing: ß and ẞ -> ss, æ/Æ -> ae, ø/Ø -> o, œ/Œ -> oe, đ/Đ -> d, ł/Ł -> l, þ/Þ -> th, ð/Ð -> d. (2) Apply Unicode NFKD normalization (so compatibility forms decompose: ﬁ -> fi, Ⅻ -> XII, ① -> 1) and remove combining marks U+0300-U+036F. (3) Remove apostrophes (' and ’) without inserting a separator (Don't -> dont). (4) Lowercase. (5) Every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] (spaces, punctuation, existing separators, any remaining non-ASCII such as CJK) is a word boundary; words are the non-empty runs of [a-z0-9]. (6) Join words with options.separator (default "-"); never emit leading, trailing or repeated separators. (7) options.maxLength (positive integer, default unlimited): if the slug is longer, keep the longest prefix made of whole words that fits; if even the first word is longer than maxLength, return that word cut to maxLength characters. Never end with a separator. (8) Empty or whitespace/punctuation-only input returns "". (9) Idempotent: slugify(slugify(x, o), o) === slugify(x, o). (10) Throw TypeError when input is not a string; throw RangeError when separator is not one of - _ . or maxLength is not a positive integer. The automated test bounties/tests/slugify.test.mjs is the acceptance gate.

criteria.description: Explains the pipeline in order: transliteration table before NFKD, NFKD + combining-mark removal, apostrophe removal, lowercasing, word splitting on non [a-z0-9], joining with the separator, and word-boundary truncation for maxLength.

Documents edge cases: empty/whitespace-only input, repeated or leading/trailing separators, sharp s and other transliterations, compatibility characters (ligatures, roman numerals, circled digits), non-latin scripts, apostrophes, first word longer than maxLength, idempotency, and invalid options/non-string input errors.
